cases.name: synchronous calls remain eager
cases.body: export function main(): string[] { const value = Layer.provide(Layer.succeed(Db, { value: () => 7 }), () => readDb()); return [String(value)] }

cases.name: an async provider keeps its capability after await
cases.body: export async function main(): Promise<string[]> { const value = await Layer.provide(Layer.succeed(Db, { value: () => 7 }), async () => { await Promise.resolve(); return readDb() }); return [String(value)] }

cases.name: ordinary native callbacks inherit an async provider
cases.body: export async function main(): Promise<string[]> { return await Layer.provide(Layer.succeed(Db, { value: () => 7 }), async () => { await Promise.resolve(); return [1, 2].map(value => String(value + readDb())) }) }

cases.name: interleaved sibling providers do not exchange capabilities
cases.body: export async function main(): Promise<string[]> { const values = await Promise.all([Layer.provide(Layer.succeed(Db, { value: () => 1 }), async () => { await Promise.resolve(); await Promise.resolve(); return readDb() }), Layer.provide(Layer.succeed(Db, { value: () => 2 }), async () => { await Promise.resolve(); return readDb() })]); return values.map(value => String(value)) }

cases.name: nested distinct providers inherit the outer async scope
cases.body: export async function main(): Promise<string[]> { return await Layer.provide(Layer.succeed(Db, { value: () => 7 }), async () => { await Promise.resolve(); const value = await Layer.provide(Layer.succeed(Cfg, { value: () => 3 }), async () => { await Promise.resolve(); return readDb() + readCfg() }); return [String(value), String(readDb())] }) }

cases.name: a synchronous nested provider restores the async outer environment
cases.body: export async function main(): Promise<string[]> { return await Layer.provide(Layer.succeed(Db, { value: () => 7 }), async () => { await Promise.resolve(); const value = Layer.provide(Layer.succeed(Cfg, { value: () => 3 }), () => readDb() + readCfg()); await Promise.resolve(); return [String(value), String(readDb())] }) }

cases.name: a fallible async delimiter keeps its provider
cases.body:
async function answer(): Promise<Result<number, Error>> { await Promise.resolve(); return readDb() }
export async function main(): Promise<string[]> { return await Layer.provide(Layer.succeed(Db, { value: () => 7 }), async () => { const value = await answer(); return [value.match({ ok: value => String(value), error: error => error.message })] }) }

cases.name: async failure cleanup keeps its provider until completion
a declared async callback keeps its provider
cases.body:
async function answer(): Promise<number> { await Promise.resolve(); return readDb() }
export async function main(): Promise<string[]> { return [String(await Layer.provide(Layer.succeed(Db, { value: () => 7 }), answer))] }

cases.name: a synchronous callback may return an owned async computation
cases.body:
async function answer(): Promise<number> { await Promise.resolve(); return readDb() }
export async function main(): Promise<string[]> { return [String(await Layer.provide(Layer.succeed(Db, { value: () => 7 }), () => answer()))] }

cases.name: a provider preserves the identity of an existing Promise
cases.body: export async function main(): Promise<string[]> { const existing = Promise.resolve(7); const provided = Layer.provide(Layer.succeed(Db, { value: () => 7 }), () => existing); const same = existing === provided; const value = await provided; await existing; return [String(same), String(value)] }

cases.name: a callback with a mixed sync and async completion keeps its scope
a conditionally awaited provider still leaves an unowned path
cases.body: export async function main(flag: boolean): Promise<string[]> { const work = Layer.provide(Layer.succeed(Db, { value: () => 7 }), async () => { await Promise.resolve(); return readDb() }); if (flag) await work; return [] }

cases.name: a mixed completion must still be consumed on every path
cases.body:
async function answer(): Promise<number> { await Promise.resolve(); return readDb() }
export async function main(flag: boolean, consume: boolean): Promise<string[]> { const value = Layer.provide(Layer.succeed(Db, { value: () => 7 }), () => flag ? answer() : 3); if (consume) await value; return [] }

cases.name: awaiting a choice does not join an array of child Promises
a scalar type assertion cannot turn an array of Promises into a join
cases.body:
function children(): Promise<number>[] { return [Promise.resolve(1)] }
export async function main(): Promise<string[]> { await (children() as unknown as number); return [] }

cases.name: an unconsumed combinator does not own async provider callbacks
cases.body: export function main(): string[] { Promise.all([Layer.provide(Layer.succeed(Db, { value: () => 7 }), async () => { await Promise.resolve(); return readDb() })]); return [] }
